verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships a first-party Python API with transformers-style `AutoModel`/`AutoConfig`/`AutoEngine` classes, including `AutoEngine.from_pretrained(...)`, so developers can call the runtime directly from Python. It also exposes an OpenAI-compatible HTTP server. However, the evidence shows only a loading snippet, with no documented generation API, packaging or reference docs. There is no official JavaScript or other-language client library, and OpenAI compatibility alone is not an official client. missing for 10: official JavaScript/other-language SDKs, documented Python inference/generation API surface and install/package docs, independent corroboration of the Python library in use.
